analysis.prompt:
You are helping a homeowner plan paint and flooring. The first 1 image(s) are photos of rooms, numbered 0 to 0 in order.
For each room photo, give its index, the kind of room, a short title a homeowner would use (for example "Living room", "Front bedroom", "Kitchen"), and what the floor is now covered with. If two photos show the same kind of room, make the titles distinct. List each photo once. Also estimate the room's floor size by eye as approxWidthFt and approxLengthFt, using things of known size as the scale (an interior door is about 3 ft wide and 6 ft 8 in tall; a queen bed is 5 ft by 6 ft 8 in; kitchen counters are 2 ft deep); 0 for both if the photo shows too little of the room to tell.
There are no floor plans; return an empty plans list.
Also return ceiling: These 1 photo(s) show rooms in one home. Estimate the typical ceiling height in feet. Use a standard interior door as the scale: its opening is about 80 inches (6 ft 8 in) tall, so compare the door's height with the wall from floor to ceiling. Round to the nearest half foot. Give basis "door" if you used a door, "other cue" if you used something else of known size, and "none" if nothing in the photos gives a scale.
